newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 meeting may be held late Jan - monetary source.
newsitem.headline: G7 meeting may be held late Jan - monetary source.

text.p: The next meeting of finance ministers and central bankers of the Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations is likely to be held in late January or in February, an international monetary source told Reuters.

He said there was a chance the United States would call on Japan to maintain its low interest rate policy as a planned increase in the consumption tax on April 1, 1997, may cloud prospects for Japan's economic recovery.
In the past several years, G7 ministers and central bankers have met a few times a year, including a regular meeting at the beginning of each year.
Jiji News Agency said the next G7 finance ministers' and central bankers' meeting was likely to be held in Berlin.
